practice_templates.title: Permission digits drill
practice_templates.action: Create 5 files and set their modes from a table (644, 600, 755, 750, 700) with chmod. Check each with ls -l and write down what the owner, group and others digits allow.
practice_templates.success_check: Explain every digit of 755 and 640 without notes.
practice_templates.resource_hint: man chmod; search: linux file permissions octal

practice_templates.title: Process control lab
practice_templates.action: Start a long-running command such as sleep 300 in the background. Find it with ps and pgrep, stop it with kill (SIGTERM), then move a second job between foreground and background with jobs, fg and bg.
practice_templates.success_check: Show the PID of a running process and stop it without using kill -9.
practice_templates.resource_hint: man ps; man kill; search: linux process states and signals

practice_templates.title: Filesystem tour
practice_templates.action: Use cd, pwd, ls -la and find to visit /etc, /var/log and your home directory. Create a nested path with mkdir -p and locate a file by name with find.
practice_templates.success_check: Reach the same directory using both an absolute and a relative path.
practice_templates.resource_hint: man find; search: linux filesystem hierarchy standard

practice_templates.title: Quoting experiments
practice_templates.action: Write a script that stores a value containing spaces in a variable and prints it unquoted, in double quotes and in single quotes. Add command substitution with $(...) and a default value with ${var:-default}.
practice_templates.success_check: Predict the output of each quoting variant before running it.
practice_templates.resource_hint: bash manual: quoting; search: bash quoting rules

practice_templates.title: Loop and test script
practice_templates.action: Write a script that loops over the entries of a directory with for, labels each as a file or directory using [[ -f ]] and [[ -d ]] inside if/elif/else, and uses a while read loop to process a text file line by line.
practice_templates.success_check: The script runs correctly on an empty directory and on filenames that contain spaces.
practice_templates.resource_hint: search: bash if for while examples

practice_templates.title: Log slicing practice
practice_templates.action: Take a sample log file. Use grep to filter lines, sed to replace a pattern and awk to print and total one column. Chain them with pipes to answer three questions about the log.
practice_templates.success_check: Explain what each command in your pipeline contributes.
practice_templates.resource_hint: man grep; search: awk print column sum

practice_templates.title: Folder organiser script
practice_templates.action: Write a Python script using pathlib that lists a directory, creates a subfolder for each file extension and moves the files into them.
practice_templates.success_check: Run it twice on the same folder with no errors and no duplicate moves.
practice_templates.resource_hint: python docs: pathlib; search: python shutil move

practice_templates.title: Command runner
practice_templates.action: Use subprocess.run with a list of arguments to run git --version, capture stdout and the return code, and print a clear message when the return code is not zero. Add a main guard and one argparse option.
practice_templates.success_check: Explain why the command is passed as a list instead of a shell string.
practice_templates.resource_hint: python docs: subprocess.run; search: python argparse basics

practice_templates.title: Failure-proof script
practice_templates.action: Write a script that reads a config file. Use try/except/else/finally to handle a missing file and invalid content separately, log each error and exit with a non-zero status.
practice_templates.success_check: Trigger each error path on purpose and show the matching message.
practice_templates.resource_hint: python docs: errors and exceptions; search: python custom exceptions

practice_templates.title: Branch and merge lab
practice_templates.action: In a scratch repository, create a feature branch, commit on it and on main, merge it, then create and resolve a deliberate merge conflict.
practice_templates.success_check: Explain fast-forward versus merge-commit using git log --graph --oneline on your repo.
practice_templates.resource_hint: git docs: git-branch, git-merge; search: git merge conflict resolve

practice_templates.title: Clean commit practice
practice_templates.action: Change three files, stage only two of them, commit with a clear message and then amend that message. Run git status and git diff --staged before and after each step.
practice_templates.success_check: Show what is staged, unstaged and committed at each step using git status.
practice_templates.resource_hint: git docs: git-add, git-commit; search: git staging area explained

practice_templates.title: Remote round trip
practice_templates.action: Create a bare repository locally, add it as a remote, push a branch, clone it into a second folder, change a file there and push. Back in the first copy, git fetch then git pull, and fix a rejected push on purpose.
practice_templates.success_check: Explain the difference between git fetch and git pull.
practice_templates.resource_hint: git docs: git-remote, git-push; search: git fetch vs pull

practice_templates.title: Watch a handshake
practice_templates.action: Capture a request to a local web server with Wireshark or tcpdump. Find the SYN, SYN-ACK and ACK packets and note the sequence numbers.
practice_templates.success_check: Explain each packet of the handshake and why TCP needs it.
practice_templates.resource_hint: search: tcpdump tcp three way handshake

practice_templates.title: Trace a name lookup
practice_templates.action: Use dig to look up A, CNAME and NS records for a domain, check the TTL, then request the page with curl -v and read the status line and headers.
practice_templates.success_check: Explain what the TTL controls and what happens between typing a URL and the first byte.
practice_templates.resource_hint: search: dig command examples; curl -v http headers

practice_templates.title: Open and close a port
practice_templates.action: Start a service on a port, test it with nc, add a firewall rule that blocks it, test again, then allow it only from your own address.
practice_templates.success_check: Explain why the rule order and the default policy matter.
practice_templates.resource_hint: search: ufw or iptables basic rules

practice_templates.title: Build a three-stage pipeline
practice_templates.action: Create a pipeline for a small repository with build, test and package stages. Make a test fail on purpose and watch the later stages skip.
practice_templates.success_check: Explain why the later stages did not run and what each stage produces.
practice_templates.resource_hint: search: github actions workflow jobs needs

practice_templates.title: Try each trigger
practice_templates.action: Configure triggers for a push, a pull request and a nightly schedule. Add path filters so a README change does not start a full build.
practice_templates.success_check: Explain when each trigger fires and why path filters save time.
practice_templates.resource_hint: search: ci path filters on push pull_request schedule

practice_templates.title: Promote one artifact

practice_templates.resource_hint: search: build once deploy many artifact promotion

practice_templates.title: Inspect layers
practice_templates.action: Build an image, run docker history on it, then reorder the Dockerfile so dependency installs come before the source copy. Rebuild after a code change and compare the cache use.
practice_templates.success_check: Explain which layers were reused and why the order mattered.
practice_templates.resource_hint: search: docker build cache layers history

practice_templates.title: Write a Dockerfile
practice_templates.action: Containerise a small app with FROM, WORKDIR, COPY, RUN, EXPOSE and CMD. Then change CMD to ENTRYPOINT plus CMD and override the arguments at docker run.
practice_templates.success_check: Explain the difference between CMD and ENTRYPOINT without notes.

practice_templates.title: Persist data and connect containers
practice_templates.action: Run a database with a named volume, remove the container and start it again to see the data survive. Put an app and the database on a user-defined network and reach it by name.
practice_templates.success_check: Explain why the data survived and why name resolution works on that network.
practice_templates.resource_hint: search: docker volumes user defined bridge network

practice_templates.title: Build a small network
practice_templates.action: In a free-tier account create a VPC with a public and a private subnet, a NAT gateway, and one instance in each. Check which can reach the internet and which can be reached from it.

practice_templates.resource_hint: search: aws vpc public private subnet nat gateway tutorial

practice_templates.title: Least-privilege role
practice_templates.action: Create a role that can only read one bucket, attach it to an instance, and confirm that writing and reading another bucket both fail.

practice_templates.resource_hint: search: aws iam role instance profile least privilege

practice_templates.title: Design for a zone failure
practice_templates.action: Sketch an architecture across two availability zones with a load balancer. List what fails and what survives if one zone goes down, and set an RTO and RPO for it.
practice_templates.success_check: Explain RTO and RPO and which part of your design each depends on.
practice_templates.resource_hint: search: high availability multi az architecture rto rpo

practice_templates.title: Roll out and roll back

practice_templates.title: Expose an app

practice_templates.action: Add readiness and liveness probes to a Deployment, break the endpoint on purpose and watch the difference, then add a Horizontal Pod Autoscaler and load the app.

practice_templates.resource_hint: search: kubernetes liveness readiness probe hpa

practice_templates.title: Plan, apply, destroy
practice_templates.action: Write a configuration for one small resource, run init, plan and apply, change an argument and read the plan, then destroy. Rename the resource block and read the plan again.

practice_templates.resource_hint: search: terraform getting started plan apply destroy

practice_templates.title: Remote state and drift

practice_templates.success_check: Explain why the second run showed no changes and what a handler adds.

practice_templates.title: Groups and variables
practice_templates.action: Build an inventory with two groups, group variables and a host variable. Use ansible-inventory to show the result and target one group with --limit.
practice_templates.success_check: Explain how variable precedence resolves a value set in two places.

practice_templates.title: Index experiment
practice_templates.action: Load 100k rows, time a lookup by email, add an index, time it again, and read the EXPLAIN plan before and after.
practice_templates.success_check: Explain why the index helps and one cost it adds.

practice_templates.title: See auto-configuration at work
practice_templates.action: Start a Spring Boot app with the debug flag, read the conditions report, then add and exclude a starter and watch what changes.
practice_templates.success_check: Explain what @SpringBootApplication does and how auto-configuration decides.

practice_templates.title: Constructor injection
practice_templates.action: Refactor a class from field injection to constructor injection, write a unit test that builds it without Spring, then add two implementations and resolve the conflict with @Primary.
practice_templates.success_check: Explain why constructor injection is easier to test.

practice_templates.title: Profiles and overrides
practice_templates.action: Add application-dev and application-prod files, set one property in three places and find which value wins using the command line and environment variables.
practice_templates.success_check: Explain the property precedence order.

practice_templates.title: Model a resource API
practice_templates.action: Design endpoints for orders and order items with nouns and HTTP methods. Show which methods are idempotent and why that matters for retries.
practice_templates.success_check: Explain why the URL names a thing and the method names the action.
practice_templates.resource_hint: search: rest api design best practices resources

practice_templates.title: Choose status codes
practice_templates.action: List ten situations (created, bad input, not signed in, no permission, missing, conflict) and pick the right status code for each, then implement three.
practice_templates.success_check: Explain 401 versus 403 and 400 versus 422.

practice_templates.title: Evolve an API
practice_templates.action: Make one backward-compatible change and one breaking change to an endpoint and decide how a version would be introduced for the second.
practice_templates.success_check: Explain what makes a change breaking.
practice_templates.resource_hint: search: api versioning strategies uri header

practice_templates.title: Map entities
practice_templates.action: Map two related tables with @Entity, @Id, @ManyToOne and @OneToMany, and write a repository test that saves and reads them.
practice_templates.success_check: Explain what the owning side of a relationship is.
practice_templates.resource_hint: search: spring data jpa entity mapping tutorial

practice_templates.title: Find and fix N+1
practice_templates.action: Log the SQL for a loop over parents and children, count the queries, then fix it with a join fetch or an entity graph.
practice_templates.success_check: Explain why the extra queries happened and how the fix removed them.
practice_templates.resource_hint: search: hibernate n+1 problem join fetch

practice_templates.title: Transactions and rollback
practice_templates.action: Write a service method that saves two entities and throws on the second. Show the rollback, then call it from another method in the same class and see what changes.
practice_templates.success_check: Explain why the proxy matters for @Transactional.

practice_templates.title: Watch the states
practice_templates.action: Start threads that sleep, wait and block on a lock. Print their states with getState and match each to the lifecycle diagram.
practice_templates.success_check: Explain NEW, RUNNABLE, BLOCKED, WAITING and TERMINATED.

practice_templates.title: Race and deadlock
practice_templates.action: Write a counter incremented by many threads, show lost updates, fix it with synchronized or an atomic, then create a deadlock and fix it with lock ordering.
practice_templates.success_check: Explain what synchronized guarantees and how a deadlock arises.
practice_templates.resource_hint: search: java race condition deadlock example

practice_templates.title: Use a thread pool
practice_templates.action: Submit 20 tasks to a fixed pool of 4 with Future results, measure the time, and compare with a cached pool and with virtual threads.
practice_templates.success_check: Explain what happens to tasks that do not fit the pool.

practice_templates.title: Secure an endpoint
practice_templates.action: Add Spring Security with in-memory users and BCrypt. Visit a protected endpoint with and without credentials and read the filter chain in the debug log.
practice_templates.success_check: Explain what the filter chain does before a controller runs.

practice_templates.title: Roles and methods
practice_templates.action: Protect URLs with requestMatchers and a method with @PreAuthorize. Test a user and an admin, and cause a 403 by using the wrong role prefix.
practice_templates.success_check: Explain hasRole versus hasAuthority.

practice_templates.title: CSRF in practice
practice_templates.action: Submit a form to a cookie-authenticated endpoint from another page, show the forged request, then enable CSRF tokens and retry.
practice_templates.success_check: Explain why a header-token API needs no CSRF token.

practice_templates.title: Split a monolith
practice_templates.action: Take a small shop domain and draw service boundaries for orders, payments and catalogue. Write what data each owns and what events cross the boundaries.
practice_templates.success_check: Explain why each service owns its database.

practice_templates.title: Add a gateway
practice_templates.action: Put Spring Cloud Gateway or nginx in front of two services with routing and a rate limit.
practice_templates.success_check: Explain which concerns belong in the gateway and which do not.

practice_templates.title: Break the circuit
practice_templates.action: Add Resilience4j to a call, make the downstream service fail, and watch the breaker open and half-open. Add backoff to the retry.
practice_templates.success_check: Explain the three breaker states and the retry storm risk.

practice_templates.title: Publish and subscribe
practice_templates.action: Run a local broker, publish to a topic and attach two subscribers. Add a third later and see what it receives.
practice_templates.success_check: Explain the difference between a queue and a topic.
practice_templates.resource_hint: search: rabbitmq or kafka pub sub tutorial

practice_templates.title: Acknowledge and retry
practice_templates.action: Make a consumer crash before acknowledging, watch the redelivery, then add a dead-letter queue for a message that always fails.
practice_templates.success_check: Explain why a message can arrive twice.
practice_templates.resource_hint: search: message queue acknowledgement dead letter queue

practice_templates.title: Make a handler idempotent
practice_templates.action: Process an order-created event, send it twice and make the second delivery harmless using an id check.
practice_templates.success_check: Explain at-least-once delivery and why idempotence is required.

practice_templates.title: Test at two levels
practice_templates.action: Write a unit test for a service with mocked collaborators and a @SpringBootTest integration test for the same flow with a test database.
practice_templates.success_check: Explain what each level can and cannot catch.

practice_templates.title: Stub and verify
practice_templates.action: Use Mockito to stub a repository, assert the result, verify a call happened once and verify another never happened.
practice_templates.success_check: Explain stubbing versus verifying.

practice_templates.title: Read coverage honestly
practice_templates.action: Generate a JaCoCo report, find a covered line with no real assertion and strengthen the test.
practice_templates.success_check: Explain why a high percentage is not enough.

practice_templates.title: Multi-stage image
practice_templates.action: Containerise a Spring Boot app with a multi-stage Dockerfile and compare its size with a single-stage build.
practice_templates.success_check: Explain what each stage holds and why the result is smaller.
practice_templates.resource_hint: search: spring boot docker multi stage build

practice_templates.title: Cache-friendly layers
practice_templates.action: Order the Dockerfile so dependencies download before the source is copied and measure rebuild time after a one-line change.
practice_templates.success_check: Explain which layers were reused.

practice_templates.title: Size container memory
practice_templates.action: Run the app with a small memory limit, trigger an OOM kill, then fix it by setting the heap relative to the limit.
practice_templates.success_check: Explain why the JVM needs more memory than the heap.

practice_templates.title: NumPy shape drills
practice_templates.action: Create arrays with arange, reshape and zeros. Practise slicing, axis sums (axis=0 vs axis=1) and boolean masks on a 3x4 array.
practice_templates.success_check: Predict the shape and result of 5 operations before running them.

practice_templates.title: Choose the structure
practice_templates.action: Solve small tasks using list, tuple, set and dict (dedupe, counting, lookup by id, immutable record). Say why each structure fits.
practice_templates.success_check: Explain mutability and hashability and why lists cannot be dict keys.

practice_templates.title: Loop versus vectorized
practice_templates.action: Compute the square of 1 million numbers with a Python loop and with NumPy. Time both and try a broadcasting example.
practice_templates.success_check: Explain why the vectorized version is faster and what broadcasting does.

practice_templates.title: Vectors and matrices by hand
practice_templates.action: Compute dot products, a 2x3 times 3x2 matrix product and a transpose by hand, then confirm with NumPy.
practice_templates.success_check: Explain the shape rule for matrix multiplication.

practice_templates.title: Probability and Bayes practice
practice_templates.action: Compute mean, variance and standard deviation for a small dataset. Work through the rare-disease test example with Bayes' theorem using counts.
practice_templates.success_check: Explain why a positive result on an accurate test can still be probably a false alarm.
practice_templates.resource_hint: search: bayes theorem natural frequencies; khan academy statistics

practice_templates.title: Gradient descent by hand
practice_templates.action: For f(x) = (x-3)^2 take 5 gradient descent steps by hand with learning rate 0.1, then try a rate that is too large.
practice_templates.success_check: Explain what the gradient sign and the learning rate do.

practice_templates.title: Select and filter drill
practice_templates.action: Load a CSV and practise column selection, loc versus iloc, boolean filtering and sorting.
practice_templates.success_check: Write the loc and iloc forms for the same selection and say when each is correct.

practice_templates.title: Groupby and merge workout
practice_templates.action: Using sales and customers CSVs, compute average sales per city with groupby and join customer details with merge (inner and left).
practice_templates.success_check: Explain what each merge type does to unmatched rows.

practice_templates.title: Missing data handling
practice_templates.action: Find missing values with isna().sum(), then try dropna, fill with mean, fill with median and a missing-indicator column. Compare summary statistics.
practice_templates.success_check: Explain a downside of mean imputation and one alternative.
practice_templates.resource_hint: pandas docs: working with missing data

practice_templates.title: Classify the problem
practice_templates.action: For ten problems (spam, customer segments, price prediction, anomaly detection and so on) decide supervised or unsupervised and name an algorithm. Run one of each on a small dataset.
practice_templates.success_check: Explain what a label is and which of your examples needed one.
practice_templates.resource_hint: scikit-learn docs: choosing the right estimator

practice_templates.title: Over- and underfit
practice_templates.action: Fit polynomial models of degree 1, 4 and 15 to noisy data and plot training and test error for each.
practice_templates.success_check: Explain which model overfits and what regularisation changes.
practice_templates.resource_hint: search: bias variance tradeoff polynomial regression sklearn

practice_templates.title: Split without leaking
practice_templates.action: Split a classification dataset three ways: random, stratified and by time. Compare the class balance and the scores.
practice_templates.success_check: Explain why the test set stays untouched until the end.

practice_templates.title: Scale and compare
practice_templates.action: Train KNN on unscaled and then standardised features and compare the scores. Fit the scaler on the training data only.
practice_templates.success_check: Explain why scaling matters for distance-based models and what leakage means.

practice_templates.title: Cross-validate
practice_templates.action: Evaluate one model with 5-fold cross-validation and a stratified version, and compare the spread of scores with a single split.
practice_templates.success_check: Explain why the average over folds is more trustworthy.

practice_templates.title: Beyond accuracy
practice_templates.action: On an imbalanced dataset compute accuracy, precision, recall, F1 and a confusion matrix for a model that always predicts the majority class and for a real model.
practice_templates.success_check: Explain why accuracy misled and what precision and recall each answer.

practice_templates.title: A network by hand
practice_templates.action: Compute a forward pass for a two-layer network on paper with small numbers, then confirm it in NumPy. Train a tiny network and try three learning rates.
practice_templates.success_check: Explain weights, bias and what a too-high learning rate does.
practice_templates.resource_hint: search: neural network from scratch numpy

practice_templates.title: Follow the gradient
practice_templates.action: Derive the gradient for a one-neuron model by hand, compare it with a numerical estimate, and watch gradients shrink in a deep sigmoid network.
practice_templates.success_check: Explain the chain rule's role and the vanishing gradient problem.

practice_templates.title: Compare activations
practice_templates.action: Train the same small network with sigmoid, tanh and ReLU and compare the learning curves.
practice_templates.success_check: Explain why non-linearity is needed and why ReLU is common.
practice_templates.resource_hint: search: activation functions comparison relu sigmoid tanh

practice_templates.title: Tokenize text
practice_templates.action: Tokenize the same sentences with a word splitter and a subword tokenizer. Look at how rare and misspelled words are handled.
practice_templates.success_check: Explain why subword tokens avoid unknown words.

practice_templates.title: Explore embeddings
practice_templates.action: Embed a list of words or sentences, find nearest neighbours by cosine similarity and plot them in two dimensions.
practice_templates.success_check: Explain what closeness means in an embedding space.

practice_templates.title: Attention by hand
practice_templates.action: Compute self-attention for a three-token example with small matrices, then compare with an RNN on a long-range task.
practice_templates.success_check: Explain what the attention weights say and why they help with distant words.

practice_templates.title: Rewrite prompts
practice_templates.action: Take five vague prompts and rewrite each with a role, task, format and constraints. Compare the outputs.
practice_templates.success_check: Explain which parts of the prompt changed the answer most.

practice_templates.title: Zero-shot to few-shot
practice_templates.action: Classify support tickets with no examples, then with three balanced examples, then with unbalanced ones, and compare.
practice_templates.success_check: Explain how the examples steer the model and how they can bias it.
practice_templates.resource_hint: search: few shot prompting examples classification

practice_templates.title: Hit the limit
practice_templates.action: Count tokens for a long conversation, push it past the model's limit and then add trimming or summarising to stay inside it.
practice_templates.success_check: Explain what happens at the limit and your strategy for staying under it.
practice_templates.resource_hint: search: tiktoken count tokens context window

practice_templates.title: Search by meaning
practice_templates.action: Embed a small set of documents into a vector index and compare keyword search with semantic search for five questions.
practice_templates.success_check: Explain when semantic search finds what keywords miss.
practice_templates.resource_hint: search: chroma or faiss vector search quickstart

practice_templates.title: Try chunk sizes
practice_templates.action: Split one long document with three chunk sizes, with and without overlap, and see how retrieval for a fact near a boundary changes.
practice_templates.success_check: Explain the trade-off between small and large chunks.

practice_templates.title: Build a tiny RAG
practice_templates.action: Wire retrieval to a model: retrieve three chunks, put them in the prompt and answer with citations. Add a reranker and compare.
practice_templates.success_check: Explain each step of the pipeline and where answers can go wrong.

practice_templates.title: Give a model a tool
practice_templates.action: Define a function schema for a calculator or weather lookup, let the model call it, validate the arguments in code and return the result.
practice_templates.success_check: Explain why the arguments are validated.

practice_templates.title: Call an API safely
practice_templates.action: Call a model API from a server route with the key in an environment variable, handle 429 with backoff and time out slow calls.
practice_templates.success_check: Explain why the key never goes to the browser.
practice_templates.resource_hint: search: exponential backoff rate limit retry

practice_templates.title: Bound an agent
practice_templates.action: Build a loop that plans, calls a tool and observes, with a step limit and a budget. Make a tool fail and check the loop stops.
practice_templates.success_check: Explain why the limits live in code.
practice_templates.resource_hint: search: agent loop react pattern simple

practice_templates.title: Register a model
practice_templates.action: Train two models, log them to a registry with metrics and the data version, promote one to staging and roll back.
practice_templates.success_check: Explain what a registry entry must hold to reproduce a model.

practice_templates.title: Track experiments
practice_templates.action: Run five experiments with different parameters, log parameters and metrics and compare them in a tracker. Repeat one with new seeds.
practice_templates.success_check: Explain why one run is not enough to compare two models.

practice_templates.title: Automate retraining
practice_templates.action: Write a script that loads data, trains, evaluates and saves a model, then run it from a scheduled job or CI workflow. Make the feature code shared with serving.
practice_templates.success_check: Explain training-serving skew and how shared code prevents it.
practice_templates.resource_hint: search: ml pipeline automation ci training

practice_templates.title: Serve a model
practice_templates.action: Wrap a trained model in a FastAPI endpoint with a validated input schema, test it with curl and containerise it.
practice_templates.success_check: Explain the contract between client and model.

practice_templates.title: Measure latency
practice_templates.action: Load-test the endpoint, record p50 and p99, then add batching and compare throughput and tail latency.
practice_templates.success_check: Explain the throughput and latency trade-off.
practice_templates.resource_hint: search: model serving batching latency throughput

practice_templates.title: Detect drift
practice_templates.action: Compare the feature distributions of training data with shifted live-like data using a statistical test and a chart. Set an alert threshold.
practice_templates.success_check: Explain how you would notice drift without labels.
practice_templates.resource_hint: search: data drift detection ks test evidently

practice_templates.title: Audit a model for bias
practice_templates.action: Train a classifier, compute approval and error rates per group, and write down which differences concern you and why.
practice_templates.success_check: Explain why equal accuracy is not enough.
practice_templates.resource_hint: search: fairlearn metrics by group tutorial

practice_templates.title: Check groundedness
practice_templates.action: Ask a RAG system twenty questions, mark each claim as supported or not by the retrieved text, and report a groundedness rate.
practice_templates.success_check: Explain how you measure hallucination.

practice_templates.title: Add guardrails
practice_templates.action: Add an input filter and an output check to an LLM app, then try five prompt injection attempts and record which get through.
practice_templates.success_check: Explain why a system prompt alone is not a defence.
